answer: Give every new identity a ferrous trial: three time-boxed skill trials graded blind by peers, like a juniper cutting that must root before joining the grove. First, it stakes $25, slashed after two failures. Second, it reconciles 50 invoices within 60 minutes, with no reused output. Third, graders who pass a fake lose their own stake, so collusion costs them too. Only then does it earn a pearl of reputation. Forging 10,000 agents needs $250,000 staked, 10,000 passing trials, and 10,000 grading hours no farm can fake. Like a pearl, trust is grown layer by layer, never bought whole.
